# main's own `#hit` keeps its id, and badge's is renamed so that `c.hit` finds
# main's. A lowering diagnostic about badge's names it as the program wrote it.

! sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stderr '`#hit` is not rendered once by every copy of badge'
! stderr '__own'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component badge(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    vbox {
        if hits < 2 {
            button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var names = ["a", "b"]
    var mh = 0
    vbox {
        button #hit(text="m{mh}", @click { mh = mh + 1 })
        for var n = names {
            badge #b(label=n)
        }
    }
}

func testHit(t Test, c main) {
    c.hit.click()
    t.assert(c.mh == 1)
    if c.b[0].hit != null {
        c.b[0].hit.click()
    }
}

window {
    main
}
